how_steps.title: Choose a program and fill in the questionnaire
how_steps.body: Pick the plan and duration, then a short questionnaire about your goal, level, available days, and any injury.

how_steps.title: Transfer the payment
how_steps.body: After the questionnaire, your order number and the account details appear. Transfer, then upload a photo of the receipt from your order page.

how_steps.title: Receive your program and start
how_steps.body: Once the transfer is verified I get in touch within 48 working hours, your program file is delivered, and follow-up begins.

about.name: Coach Sara | Nav
about.bio: Certified personal trainer, coaching since 2017. I help you build a clear training and nutrition routine that fits your goal, time, and level, with weekly follow-up that keeps you going and progressing.
about.home_bio: Certified personal trainer, coaching since 2017, and former captain of the basketball team at Imam Abdulrahman Bin Faisal University. I help you build a clear training and nutrition routine that fits your goal, time, and level, with weekly follow-up and no restrictive diets.
points: A program built on your goal and level.

about.story_title: I became the person I once needed
story: Before I became a coach, I was a trainee tired of experiments. I subscribed with coaches abroad and never found anyone who explained the exercises properly or cared about my goals.

Then I trained with Coach Sahar Alharthi. She changed how I saw training and inspired me to become a coach, and to this day I thank her for everything she taught me. That is when I decided to be the person I had needed.

Sport has been part of me from early on: I played basketball and captained the team at Imam Abdulrahman Bin Faisal University, and I competed professionally in esports. I started coaching in 2017 with basketball, worked as an assistant coach at the university club, and then coached at Pure Gym, Gymnation, Fitness Lounge, and private clubs.
about.pillars_title: What makes training with me different?

pillars.title: Your plan explained on video
pillars.body: I do not send a plan and leave it there. I walk through it with you in a video explaining everything, so you start with full understanding: what we do and why.

pillars.title: No deprivation
pillars.body: I never use restrictive diets. Your plan fits your life, not a list of banned foods.

pillars.title: Serious follow-up, realistic plan
pillars.body: I check in with you every week, care about your adherence, and adjust your plan to your progress and circumstances.

pillars.title: I teach you, not just train you
pillars.body: I have loved teaching since I was young. I share everything I know, the science and the mindset, and I never stop researching and learning so that we both improve.

fit: Anyone who believes training is a lifestyle, not a quick fix for a temporary look or just for summer.
**And if adherence slips?** I try to understand why and help you work through it as much as I can. If it is bigger than what I can offer, I say so honestly and step back from coaching you.

notes.title: For gamers
notes.body: Coming from the esports world, I designed a special plan for gamers: better fitness on and off the screen, and dealing with back and joint pain from long sitting.
notes.label: Gamers plan →

notes.title: During pregnancy
notes.body: I coach pregnant trainees in person only. Online, I cannot be sure every exercise is performed correctly, and pregnancy is a time that needs that certainty. Online, I offer nutrition follow-up only during pregnancy.
